subject: stout armoured knight in blue plate with a red plume, longsword in the right hand, kite shield on the left arm
motion: a shield bash: lunging forward and slamming the shield
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: a small white impact burst where the shield strikes

plan.source: Knight faces right in three-quarter view; left arm holds a forward kite shield, right hand hangs a longsword low to the right; feet staggered with right forward, weight centered.

frames.pose: Anticipation: torso leans back/left; shield draws in toward chest, angled back; sword hand pulls slightly rear/down; knees dip; left/back foot planted, right/front heel light; head tilts back, eyes right.
Key: lunge forward/right; shield arm fully drives out, rim leading; sword arm swings back for counterbalance; right/front foot steps and plants, left heel up; head tucked behind shield.
frames.effect: Small white impact burst at shield front rim at screen-right; thin white arc tracing shield sweep from back-left to front-right.

frames.pose: Follow-through: torso passes then checks; shield slightly past target, angled outward; sword swings forward to low across; weight splits; both feet planted, left heel settling; head peeks around shield.
Recovery: torso straightens toward ready; shield returns in front near start height; sword settles low forward; right foot slides back toward start, both planted; head upright facing right.
